_doc: Our own props in this zone (OwnProps.cs; the presets: tools/assets/env_props.json, built by env_props.py). pieces: a kit piece of props.json -> the preset standing in for it wherever it stands (fitted to the kit piece's height, on its footprint). keep: [x, z] places where the kit piece stays (another lead's). place: a preset stood at x, z (on the ground, + y), turned rot radians about up, scaled; or along a line from a to b ([x, y, z], the preset's long axis on it) at radius r (a log). bare: [r, k] the grass gone within r and thinning out to k times r (with the fires, the first four in the zone). hide: [x, z, r, max height] the web game's blocked-out meshes there go (not its kit pieces). lamps: a lamp holder's light by its glow node: color, energy (times the road lamps'), range, att. nudge: [x, z, dx, dz, degrees] the preset standing in for the kit piece at x, z shifted and turned (the chest off the log's end). drop: landmark nodes that go (the unlit standing lantern west of the camp, a crate in its place). kits (E7b): a KayKit piece of landmarks.glb (kk-PACK-NAME-N) -> our preset standing in for it (a list: the copies take them in turn by N), built in the kit piece's own units and frame so it stands where the kit piece stood, inside its collider; {"preset", "over": the made piece (Pieces.cs) stays under it, minus what the preset is (the crypt keeps its slate roof, coping and iron door), "scale"}; "flora:NAME" is one of our own trees.
